title: Analogical Reasoning with Large Language Models: A Co-Creative Framework and Benchmarking of LLMs in Design Ideation

context_summary: The study explores the use of large language models (LLMs) in design ideation, focusing on analogical reasoning and co-creative frameworks. It evaluates the creative performance of LLMs and benchmarks their outputs in analogical tasks.
